# How does SAPTO work? (Senior Australians and Pensioners Tax Offset)
## SAPTO for singles
| Single rebate income | Tax offset |
|-|-|
| $38,000 | $1,984.25 |
| $40,000 | $1,734.25 |
| $42,000 | $1,484.25 |
| $44,000 | $1,234.25 |
| $46,000 | $984.25 |
| $48,000 | $734.25 |
| $50,000 | $484.25 |
| $52,000 | $234.25 |
| $53,874 | $0.00 |

Try our [income tax calculator](https://www.superguide.com.au/super-booster/income-tax-calculator) to understand the offsets and levies that may apply to you, plus your effective tax rate.

## SAPTO for couples living together
| **Combined rebate income** | **Maximum tax offset** |
|-|-|
| $63,694 | $3,204.00 |
| $84,000 | $665.75 |
| $86,000 | $415.75 |
| $88,000 | $165.75 |

## What if you’re a couple and only one of you is eligible for SAPTO?
To work out your potential eligibility for SAPTO, go to the ATO’s [beneficiary tax offset and seniors and pensioners tax offset calculator](https://www.ato.gov.au/calculators-and-tools/tax-offsets-beneficiaries-and-seniors-and-pensioners-calculator).
